threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think 'gentrification' is a bad word, not a badge of honor. The locals aren't quite as forgiving about that one.
Heard a guy on the 47 last night arguing with a pigeon over a chip. The bus stopped, and the pigeon just stared him down like it owned the place.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a group of toddlers arguing over a lost toy in the park, while their parents sipped coffee from the nearby kiosks. That's Neukölln life.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand open at 3 AM, serving up spicy sausages to midnight cyclists. Pure Berlin vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Real locals know to wear shoes that can handle a sudden BART shutdown—flip-flops don’t cut it when you’re forced to walk to 16th St.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading the bus passengers with an accordion on Market St. Half the riders were tapping their feet, completely forgetting the delay.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the plazas, but the real heart beats in the back alleys where the local bars pour vermut like it's water.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You’ll see them struggling with the metro map while eyeing the T10 card machine like it's a puzzle box. It's the classic lost-in-translation look.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look bewildered when the 243 bus actually shows up on time. The locals just roll their eyes and keep scrolling.
Last night on the 137, a bloke serenaded the driver with an off-key rendition of 'Wonderwall'—even the drunk passengers stopped to listen.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I heard a full-on dance party spilling out of a backyard while I was waiting for the 171 bus. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You ever notice the spontaneous dance parties in U-Bahn stations? It’s like the city's heartbeat - a rhythm you can't find anywhere else.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot locals by their reaction to the Muni delays—if they roll their eyes and keep scrolling on their phones, they’re native.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5-Fulton stuck behind a street performer doing magic tricks at Taylor. No one was mad; the whole bus just vibed with the show.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every bar in Gràcia serves 'tapas'—but half the spots specialize in 'pintxos' instead. Totally different vibe, totally different snack.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they struggle to find the right bus stop; locals know the hidden ones behind Plaça del Sol without a second thought.
